 We are looking for professionals with expertise in Microsoft 365 consulting, migration and modernization to join our AI Workforce Consulting team. This is an opportunity to contribute to large transformation programs while supporting the growth of our Microsoft 365 service offerings.

* Work with client and project teams to understand business requirements, current\-state environments and modernization objectives.
* Design and deliver SharePoint Online and Microsoft 365 solutions using SPFx, Microsoft Graph, PnP and PowerShell.
* Plan and execute Microsoft 365 migrations, including SharePoint, OneDrive and Teams workloads, with appropriate assessment, remediation, testing and cutover activities.
* Assess and modernize Nintex workflows and forms, including Nintex for SharePoint and Nintex Automation Cloud.
* Prepare technical designs, migration plans, mapping documents, test scripts, deployment guides and operational handover documentation.
* Troubleshoot migration, workflow, solution and integration issues, escalating risks and dependencies when required.
* Ensure deliverables comply with project standards, security requirements, governance processes and technical design principles.
* Support estimates, solution demonstrations, proof of concepts and technical discussions with stakeholders.
* Develop reusable assets, accelerators and best practices for Microsoft 365 migration and modernization engagements.
* Collaborate effectively with globally distributed teams and contribute to knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.

* 5\-8 years of relevant technology consulting experience, including substantial experience in Microsoft 365, SharePoint migration or modernization.
* Strong hands\-on experience with SharePoint Framework (SPFx), TypeScript, React, Fluent UI, JavaScript, HTML and CSS.
* Good knowledge of SharePoint Online architecture, information architecture, permissions, content types, site designs and governance concepts.

* Knowledge of Microsoft 365 governance, permissions, Purview, security and compliance.
* Experience with tenant\-to\-tenant, acquisition, divestiture or hybrid migrations.
* Knowledge of Azure services, integrations, Azure DevOps and CI/CD.

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving ability
* Self\-starter with a strong drive to learn and adopt new technologies
